name: Display assembly
notes: Cover glass + touch digitiser + panel. Variant by panel tech (OLED/LCD) and with/without frame

name: Display adhesive / gasket
notes: Pre-cut foam or glue; model-specific cut

name: Mid-frame / chassis
notes: Metal or plastic body; often sold with button flex; SIM tray separate

name: SIM tray
notes: Colour-matched; single/dual/hybrid

name: Power and volume button flex
notes: Side-key flex and button caps

name: Front camera
notes: Selfie camera module

name: Earpiece speaker
notes: Top receiver speaker

name: Logic board / motherboard
notes: Sold by storage/RAM variant; IMEI-locked on some brands

name: Rear camera module
notes: Main / ultra-wide / macro / telephoto as separate items on many models

name: Rear camera lens glass
notes: Glass cover for the camera island, with adhesive

name: Battery
notes: Capacity in mAh; with pull-tab adhesive

name: Charging port / sub-board
notes: USB-C, Micro-USB or Lightning; often includes mic and SIM reader

name: Loudspeaker
notes: Bottom speaker module

name: Vibration motor
notes: Coin or linear motor

name: Fingerprint sensor
notes: Rear, side-key or in-display (optical/ultrasonic) depending on model

name: Wireless charging coil + NFC
notes: Only on models with wireless charging; NFC antenna separate on others

name: NFC antenna
notes: On NFC models without wireless charging

name: Back panel / rear glass
notes: With camera lens cover on some; with adhesive

name: Main / inter-connect flex
notes: Board-to-sub-board flex cable

name: Proximity / light sensor flex
notes: Model-specific

name: Tempered glass / screen protector
notes: Full-cover, edge-to-edge, privacy, matte

name: Case / back cover
notes: Silicone, hard, flip, wallet, transparent

name: Camera lens protector
notes: Tempered glass ring for the camera island

name: Charger adapter
notes: Wattage matched to the phone's fast-charge standard

name: Charging cable
notes: USB-C to USB-C / USB-A to USB-C / Lightning

name: Earphones
notes: Wired (3.5 mm or USB-C) or TWS

name: Holders and stands
notes: Car vent, dashboard, desk

name: Power bank
notes: By capacity and output

name: Back skin / wrap
notes: Vinyl skins
